name: Cursed Blade
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 4, lathspell 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one melee weapon
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You coat a weapon in powerful necromantic energy causing it to leave truly grievous wounds.

The weapon gains the wounding magic weapon property and any damage dealt by the weapon cannot be healed by magical or natural means until the damaged creature has been subject to a remove curse spell or similar effect which would remove a curse. If a creature is slain by a weapon benefiting from this spell the body must likewise be purged of this effect before the creature can be raised or resurrected.
